transcript: My most expensive habit? Saying yes… before I'd even thought about it. One little yes. Then the money. The time. The stuff I didn't need. So I tried something awkward. I paused. What does it cost? Will I use it? Does it fit my life? Turns out… a good choice can wait for you.
